svg.title: A job's cores spread over several NUMA domains
svg.desc: Each picture shows one Genoa socket with 4 NUMA domains. A job with all its cores in one NUMA domain fetches its data from close by, which is fast. The same job spread over three NUMA domains has to fetch some of its data from another domain, which is slower.
svg.text: 1. The job's cores are spread over several NUMA domains
All the job's cores are in one domain,
so its data is close by.
Its cores are in three domains, so some
a core your job is using
fetch from its own NUMA domain (fast)
